We have evidence:
- CLOUD-2018: Within an EU, seeding is randomly assigned to one range and not the other. Authors explicitly say Medicine Bow assignment plot would have opposite shading from Sierra Madre plot. 154 EUs etc.
- Scope: 118 quality-controlled EUs used in WWMPP primary analysis. One EU includes paired ranges. Target sites HY and GL; auxiliary gauges and possible cross-range contamination do not redefine assigned treatment.
Question q1: How are the two range-level seeding assignments related within one retained EU? Options:
 both_seeded: Both ranges assigned seeding together as one treated pair.
 complementary_assignment: One joint allocation selects the seeded range, and the other receives complementary unseeded assignment.
 conflicting
 independent_assignments: Each range independently randomized, so both/neither can be assigned seeding.
 not_stated
 other
 permanent_range
Evidence says seeding randomly assigned to one range and not other within EU; opposite shading. That is complementary assignment. So q1 complementary_assignment.

Question q2: Does assigned-unseeded label, by itself, establish zero physical exposure to seeding material in this study? Options:
 assignment_only: No; it establishes planned allocation, while physical exposure requires additional evidence because cross-range contamination is discussed.
 conflicting
 exposure_confirmed_everywhere: No; label establishes that every unseeded range-period was physically exposed...
 not_stated
 zero_exposure_established: Yes; assignment to unseeded range establishes it received no seeding material.
Evidence: CLOUD-2014 slide 24 reports ground-based ice-nucleus measurements indicating silver iodide reached Medicine Bow in 21 Sierra Madre seeding cases. Slide 29 modeled enhanced precipitation in Medicine Bow during Sierra Madre seeding. Scope says possible cross-range contamination does not redefine assigned treatment. Therefore assigned-unseeded label by itself does not establish zero exposure; assignment only, physical exposure requires evidence, cross-range contamination discussed. So q2 assignment_only. Need be careful: Does evidence "by itself" establish zero exposure? It says no because contamination. Option assignment_only fits: No; establishes planned allocation, physical exposure requires additional evidence because cross-range contamination is discussed. exposure_confirmed_everywhere says No; label establishes that every unseeded range-period was physically exposed. That's not correct; only some cases? It says 21 cases of 118? not every. So assignment_only.

Need final JSON. Ensure no extra text. Could include option ids. Need maybe "required JSON object". final {"q1":"complementary_assignment","q2":"assignment_only"}.
